name: Sanctification
overview: Sanctification in Scripture is presented as God's setting apart of people, places, and things for His holy purposes. From the consecration of the firstborn among Israel (Exodus 13:2) to the sanctifying of the entire nation (Exodus 19:10,14), God calls His people to be distinct and holy. Material objects such as the altar and the tabernacle are sanctified through anointing and God's presence (Exodus 29:37,43), emphasizing that sanctification involves both divine appointment and separation unto service. This theme reveals that sanctification is a divine act that establishes holiness and fellowship between God and His people.
